# CI pipeline failing intermittently on flaky integration tests

Developers report the pipeline randomly goes red and passes on re-run, slowing merges.

The integration test harness leaked HTTP connections across tests, eventually exhausting file descriptors and causing sporadic timeouts depending on test order.

1. Reproduce by running the full suite and watching FD count climb
2. Close/reuse HTTP clients between tests and raise the ulimit in CI
3. Add test isolation so ordering does not affect resources
4. Confirm ten consecutive green pipeline runs

Error Details
```
Test failed: 'Timed out waiting for element'; exit code 1; container ran out of file descriptors: 'too many open files' (EMFILE)
```

Tags: cicd, flaky-tests, emfile, file-descriptors, intermittent
